freeze_rule: Codex review, then status FROZEN and the file sha256 is written into every ledger header. The runner refuses any status other than READY_FOR_REVIEW (dry/measurement only) or FROZEN (training recording). No field changes during collection.
decision_source: outputs/reports/claude-arch-parallel-20261019/pairact-success-filter-decision.md (2026-10-20, success-filtered BC adopted; P1 tournament non-blocking)
start_trigger: P2 smoke passed with >=1 full-path success (grasp + carry_success) out of the smoke worlds; 0 successes -> do not collect, fix P2

success.same_as: P2 evaluator harness/pair_carry_eval.evaluate (dsh/pairact-p2-carrypath DESIGN section 5), unchanged
all_of: summary.json status == complete and HOST_ERROR == 0 for the batch, world present in summary.worlds
raw result.json status == complete (no HOST_ERROR, not interrupted)
grasp_physical_success is true (joint pick + 3 s joint hold, P1 definition)
carry_eval.success is true: beam GT footprint inside zone B, lowered, released, at rest
success.truth_scope: GT is read only by the eval-only evaluator after the episode; never by the teacher controller or student inputs

filter.train_tensor_admission: success (above) AND search_handoff == false AND approach_handoff == false AND (recording run) data_admitted == true AND both robot streams pass the stage sidecar
filter.failures: never enter tensors; raw outputs are kept untouched in the batch directories and listed in the ledger with failure stage/reason for bias analysis
filter.success_not_admitted: teacher success with a map-code handoff is counted as success for yield A but tagged success_not_admitted and excluded from tensors
filter.no_relabel: the filter is a pure function of result.json fields named above; no manual selection, no re-judging after viewing videos

visible_only + issued pose + visible_handoff_v1 recording requirements
data_admitted excludes search/approach handoffs and recording probes

recording_admission.default_off: existing candidates and the gate path are byte-identical (regression tests in each -c branch)
recording_admission.fallback: if the recording path fails on the VM the first time, pass 1 runs in measurement mode (recording off, candidate pairact_p2_r13 on the -c stack) and is reported as '수율 측정, 시연 아님' (A only)

bins.unit: episode; both robots of one attempt are drawn inside the same bin
bins.distance: planar distance from the robot spawn to the grasp point of its assigned beam end (start_layers.<rid>.target_distance_m)
bins.yaw: own heading offset relative to the assigned-end outward direction (wide_start convention). facing: wrapped offset within 90 deg of pi (robot looks at its end); away: otherwise
bins.roles: r1 end = teal if random.Random('pairact_r1_collect_v1:<seed>:role').random() < 0.5 else blue (not seed parity, which would tie roles to round-robin bins)
bins.position_bearing: radially outward from the assigned end (wide_start bearing bin 0), unchanged from the r13 wide gate
bins.draw_within_bin: per robot: distance uniform in the bin range, yaw offset uniform in the bin half-circle, rng = random.Random('pairact_r1_collect_v1:<seed>:<bin id>:<robot index>') (str seed, sha512, independent of PYTHONHASHSEED) [setup only]

targets.attempt_definition: one completed train-split teacher episode (world in summary.worlds). HOST_ERROR worlds are not attempts; they are re-queued once with the same seed and bin, a second HOST_ERROR is recorded as host_error_final and the seed is not reused
stop_rules: STOP_TARGET: admitted successes >= 200 and every bin >= 20
STOP_CAP: attempts >= 600 (report; train only if admitted >= 150, results marked 'data range limited' if any bin < 20)
STOP_HOST: two consecutive batches end with batch status HOST_ERROR
STOP_SEEDS: train seed pool exhausted (cannot happen before the cap: pool 600 = cap)
targets.below_minimum: admitted < 150 at STOP_CAP -> no P4 training; report to Claude

allocation.batch_size: fixed per run invocation (--batch-size, default 20); recorded in the ledger header
allocation.warmup: while every bin has < 4 attempts: slots are round-robin over B0..B5 continuing from the last assigned bin
allocation.deficit: need_b = max(0, 20 - success_b); p_b = (success_b + 1) / (attempts_b + 2); weight_b = need_b / max(p_b, 0.05). Slots split by largest remainder over weight_b, ties to the lower bin index
allocation.after_minimums: when every need_b == 0 but total < 200: round-robin over all bins (keeps the overall distribution near uniform)
allocation.slot_order: slots are interleaved bin by bin (B0,B1,..) so a partially run batch stays balanced
allocation.deterministic: allocation reads only the ledger; identical ledger -> identical next batch

seeds.consumption: new train attempts take the next unused seed in strict ascending order regardless of bin; a HOST_ERROR re-queue reuses its own seed and bin and consumes no new seed

validation.rule: collected once each, bin round-robin index % 6, not counted toward targets, cap or allocation; success-only into validation tensors

heldout.rule: never collected; P5 only; cases are drawn with bin = index % 6 from the same generator, no filter

seeds.overlap_check: train 8340000-8340599 must not overlap validation, heldout or seeds.json known_ranges (checked by harness.pairact_collect.check_seed_ranges and scripts/check_pairact_r1_seeds.py)
seeds.note: the train extension is registered in seeds.json train_extension and scanned by scripts/check_pairact_r1_seeds.py

dart_noise.mechanism: existing teacher --noise (result.noise = 'DART-inspired_fixed_pilot'): 5% of grasp-segment steps outside done/complete/ready apply a perturbed command; the label keeps clean_teacher_command and perturbed=true. Carry segment rows are never perturbed (pair_carry_recorder writes perturbed=false)
dart_noise.when_on: a separate run root and ledger tag noise=on; every attempt records noise mode and perturbed_rows / total_rows per robot; reports give noise-on and noise-off counts separately and never pool them silently
dart_noise.trigger_candidate: only if recover-stage rows in admitted successes are < 5% of rows after collection pass 1; needs Claude approval and a new prereg revision
dart_noise.gpu_status: [확인 필요] the -c adapter keeps noise=False for every candidate; turning DART on needs a new prereg revision and adapter change

bias_report.ks: two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov (asymptotic p) between admitted successes and failures for robot-level start distance and |yaw offset|; reported with n per group, D, p. Informational, not a gate
bias_report.per_bin_table: bin, attempts, successes, admitted, success rate, need
bias_report.recover_count: rows with teacher_phase mapped to stage recover in admitted episodes (from the stage sidecar)
bias_report.distance_gate: COLLECT_SPEC section 2: all nine 0.1 m distance bins occupied and > 0.8 m share >= 25% among admitted robot starts

reporting.A: 교사 시연 수집: 성공 n / 시도 N (데이터 필터용, 학습 결과 아님) + 구간별 표. Denominator: attempts incl. failures
reporting.B: 교사 관문 n/40 (교사 신뢰도, 학습 결과 아님). Separate run; never computed from collection attempts
reporting.C: 학습 정책 n/20, 같은 seed 교사 n/20 (보류 8342000-019, 필터 없음) + 단계 퍼널
reporting.never_pool: A, B, C are never added or averaged; CPU results and r13/smoke outcomes are never pooled with A
